notes.title: Free prologue with new boss and secret mission!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are excited to present the new and mysterious free game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/]Union of Gnomes: Prologue[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/

It combines the creepy atmosphere of dark fantasy, cheerful humor, and, of course, the daring gnomes desperately fighting for their freedom and independence. 
 
[previewyoutube=atZ26XQlAEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Lead a motley crew of guerrillas to free your captured comrades and escape the tyranny of the ruthless Snow White. For the tenacious players, we've hidden a secret quest within the prologue—conquering it will bring you closer to solving the mystery of the eighth gnome! Look for the clue in the video!

Here's what you'll find in the game:
[list]
[*] One new, unique and terribly dangerous mission!
[*] A dangerous new boss!
[*] A secret quest!
[*] A lot of well-known – and not so well-known – fairy tale characters who fight on the side of evil, trying to suppress and destroy the gnomes!
[*] Create unusual combos with your gnome cards to reach the end of the prologue or die with honor!
[/list]
Once you've finished the prologue (and added [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/]Union of Gnomes[/url] to your Steam Wishlist), you can look forward to the full story of the gnomes' heroic adventures as they fight for their freedom in the full game. The gnomes stand for freedom and the right not to impose subjugation on anyone else!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/ 

Don't forget to recommend the game to your friends and favorite streamers, share your impressions, and leave a review. 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Updated!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27103775/c92ec7e6c0a84584efd7211bc82996d3bbb8d4e1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Princes and mercenaries![/h1] ːauthorityː

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27103775/c4fc3b344bbf53209b28259c73e65c5ffebfffb6.jpg[/img]

Folly though it may seem to you, we have decided to make the greatest change in the entire history of the game’s development. All commands are now executed immediately, rather than at the end of a turn. In a single turn, we can attack with a general, immediately see the outcome of the battle and, based on that outcome, continue to move and attack with other generals, or withdraw our forces. From now on, your orders will be executed immediately, rather than on the following turn. 

We have also made enemy turns visible. You can now track the movement of their generals, the shifting of control over provinces, as well as enemy casualties and reinforcements. Study their maneuvers and plan your response, or skip the animation by simply pressing a key.

We feel that the game has become fast, dynamic, and aggressive. Try out the new rules and tell us what you think in the comments.

Before every battle, an additional formation screen is now displayed where you can see details about the enemy’s strength and position your troops before sending them into battle. 

Our work on improving the interface is nearing completion. All game screens now follow the same style. We have also moved the buttons for general commands closer to their models. The combined strength of a general’s army is displayed above their head. Uncharted lands surrounding the map are now beautifully framed.

 Take note of the new recruiting screen, in which generals have been merged with mercenaries. You can now only buy one general per turn. The game now has a cap on the total number of generals you can control.

We have also made changes to the game’s setting, bringing it closer to the genre of alternate history. All factions and soldiers are now proudly open about their historical roots. The Carolingians and the Horde, Hansa and Babylonia, the Normans and the Zoroastrians: let the paths of real historical figures cross in novel and fictional situations. Take a “what if” approach to history and discover that, which could have been... Additionally, we have reworked the tutorial to make it even more intuitive, and fixed a number of bugs, both major and minor. This is our final stretch; we are weeks away from release. Will we have the time to make the game better still? Follow our updates and you’ll find out. 

[b]’Tis Time for War![/b]

notes.title: Battle system improved!
notes.content:
[h1]Princes and mercenaries![/h1]

IMPORTANT! After the patch, all games saved mid-scenario will be LOST (but unlocked scenarios will stay unlocked and NOT be lost).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27103775/dce8d36e1a6e218b46c9bbc6421170141bbf30b6.jpg[/img]

To elaborate: due to edits made to the game data, the save format is changing. This means that after the patch, you will be UNABLE to resume a scenario where you left it off by loading a save file. However, all scenarios that you’ve unlocked will remain available, and you can start any one of them - only from the BEGINNING, though.

Balance. Armies and generals have had some of their math fixed. That’s a simple way to describe what was essentially an overhaul of the game’s entire model of calculations. We hope that this will increase the impact of every type of troop and give new meaning to old tactics. Reshuffling armies will be more intuitive and widely used. That’s not all, as far as balancing work is concerned; keep watching the updates.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27103775/c4eb11177faf121c0d0510dc8c213c3787a88392.jpg[/img]

We’ve also changed the main screen interface to make the game more comfortable. The game now has fewer unnecessary questions and prompts, formations don’t need to be confirmed anymore, you don’t have to save anything or set a default formation: these are all done automatically. A dismissed general’s troops now remain in the province, and the updated sorting mechanism for the list of generals no longer mixes them with garrisons. An alliance can be broken right from the map view, by attacking the ally. War has never been so comfortable in Dark Ages!

It’s time for a great war; it’s raiding time!
ːauthorityː

notes.title: Call to arms!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27103775/fad1a6d60b88d446549515661b6efd8043431aa3.jpg[/img]
[i]Full size pic:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27103775/fad1a6d60b88d446549515661b6efd8043431aa3.jpg
[/i]

[h1]Princes and mercenaries![/h1]

The first step of our plan is complete! ːauthorityː We’ve added a display for the previous turn. The post-turn situation is now more readable: flaming swords show the locations of battles, while arrows indicate squad movements and retreats. We’ll be waiting for your requests; write to tell us which other events from a previous turn you’d like to see.

Landscape and weather influence has become easier to plan for: weather conditions are now the same throughout the map, and their changes are more predictable. We’ve also given each sector of the map its own landscape, removing the randomness.

We’ve made general and troop abilities more organized: many of them are now used before, rather than during, a battle. This has made combat faster and more intuitive. We’re not going to stop there: this is just the beginning of our path towards perfect combat.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27103775/4486c770b10f1ff1c3f675c3afebbdf1344aaeb7.jpg[/img]

We’ve addressed crash issues, making the game even more stable. Write us if the game is now behaving itself better (or not).

In upcoming patches, we’d like to revamp the statistics and diplomacy screens. Please write us whether you use diplomacy and statistics often, and for what purposes. 

We’re also going to tackle the troop formation screen. The army needs our reforms, and it doesn’t have long to wait. Follow the news, stay with us, share your comments and requests. 

[i]It’s time for a great war; it’s raiding time![/i]

notes.title: Roadmap and fresh update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27103775/571ed3a59842251886cf832103a4558ff0897e10.jpg[/img]
[i]Full size pic: http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27103775/571ed3a59842251886cf832103a4558ff0897e10.jpg[/i]
Princes and mercenaries!

While a detailed plan is being prepared for future revisions and alterations of the game, you can try some exciting new scenarios. 

Join the Barbarian march to the Union’s capital. The name of this scenario is “Kill and Plunder”. Achieve fame as a military commander and become a great chief to the northern peoples. “A Great War,” the array of Union-supported baronies opposing the Leopard Principality, awaits you. Crush the resistance and destroy the seeds of evil. 

We have also worked on the game’s stability and tried to remove crashes. Figure inaccuracies and text typos have been fixed in some places. 

It’s time for great war, time for plunder!

P.S. As before, we are looking forward to your feedback. Tell us what changes you would like to see most, and we will try to take all your opinions into consideration. The next bit of news will contain our plan for further work, and your comments have a chance to be included. Thank you for your patience and opinions.

notes.title: Patch #1 is live!
notes.content:
Lords and mercenaries!

It's been a tough week but we are finally rolling out the very first patch which is dedicated to erase most of the critical issues.

[h1]What's new:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Initial crash is fixed;
[*]Resolution detection problem is fixed;
[*]Anti-cheat system is implemented;
[*]Plenty (~ 40) other much less significant bugs fixed.
[/list]

We've also started a feedback thread, hoping to receive some useful directions from you guys!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/508300/discussions/0/154644349175464650

New content will arrive next patch and it will be based on the feedback you give us.

Time to plunder and pillage!
